description: In rhesus macaques under graded isoflurane anesthesia imaged with high-field fMRI, deeper sedation correlated with higher mean disjointedness, lower mean promiscuity and lower mean cohesion strength, with more fragmented networks (Standage et al. 2020, as reported by Safron and colleagues).
limitations: Reported secondhand in Safron, Klimaj and Hipolito 2022. The original study is not read here. It concerns level of consciousness under anesthesia in monkeys.

sources.quote: Standage et al. (2020) observed that deeper sedation correlated with higher mean disjointedness, lower mean promiscuity, and lower mean cohesion strength
